blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Monday flagged flood control projects with “double appropriations” in the P7.2-trillion General Appropriations Bill (GAB) for 2027. “We found items for flood control projects in the budget bill. Not only were these flood control projects, there were double appropriations for them,” he said in an interview with dzMM.
